body:
STORY-1700 sketch revision 2 is ready for your signoff: PR #2722 (docs only, DO NOT MERGE), head 1cc11da17a.

- Each of your STRICT review changes 1-7 has its own section (R1-R7) with files, functions and named tests.
- The AC3 note has been added to the spec (change 5).
- One fork needs your ruling (F1): fleet_lanes::classify_lanes does not exist on origin/main, because STORY-1699 shipped only relay_stall.rs.
  - Option A (recommended): extract it in this story.
  - Option B: make it a prerequisite slice.

No implementation starts until a signoff comment is on the spec. Details: aida show STORY-1700 --comments
subject: STORY-1700 revised sketch ready for signoff (PR #2722)
